modes.sniff: the outcome is an answer, not a change — find out why, look into, how does, is it safe to
modes.build: the outcome is a change — a feature, a fix, a refactor, docs

choose.when: a long, open-ended run — weighing a design across the whole system, or tracing one symptom through several parts at once
the task is clear and its shape is already known — a described change, a test to add, a document to write
the path is bounded and understood — the change is described and only has to be made
no stated right answer, or two readings that lead to different work, or a change that reaches far
